headline: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
context: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.
